title: Init journal -- every phase of an install, written before it runs and after it concludes
description: Opened at the moment an install becomes a writer, holding every declared phase PENDING; each phase is rewritten UNSET with its start BEFORE its work and OK or ERROR after; the run closes it in a `finally`. A journal with no `ended_at` is a run that was INTERRUPTED -- killed, not refused, because a refusal is an ending -- and the next run carries it forward whole under `resumed_from` and replays. Status words are OpenTelemetry's (UNSET, OK, ERROR) plus PENDING: declared, never entered.

schema_version.description: The ONE declaration of this document's version; the writer reads it from here.

run_id.description: The run; the same identity its hold carries.

verb.description: The verb of the run carrying out the install -- an install done by an upgrade is journalled as the upgrade.

status.description: UNSET until the run declares an end.

ended_at.description: The moment the run declared its end. ABSENT means the run never came back.

phases.description: Every phase the verb declares, in its declared order, from the moment the journal opens.

resumed_from.description: The interrupted run this one supersedes: which phase it was inside, what it concluded, what it never reached, and its whole record -- carried, never discarded.

broke_lock.description: The other end of a hold broken by name: this record outlives the hold it broke.
